PDF export dependencies are bundled locally and loaded only on demand.

- jsPDF 3.0.3 — https://github.com/parallax/jsPDF (MIT, license included in the bundle).
- jsPDF AutoTable 5.0.2 — https://github.com/simonbengtsson/jsPDF-AutoTable (MIT).
- Manrope — https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/manrope (SIL Open Font License; see Manrope-OFL.txt).

`manrope-pdf-font.js` contains the base64-encoded Google Fonts Manrope TTF so export also works when the page is opened as a local file.
